identifiers.dataset_id: Opaque identifier mapped to a private path only by the local worker
identifiers.second_level_run_id: Versioned group recalculation bound to a parent result and sample version

lease.expiration: Makes a running job eligible for a later claim
lease.offline_behavior: Local MATLAB execution continues; the worker retries control-plane synchronization with bounded exponential backoff

literature_guidance.reasoning: Performed by the MCP client model
literature_guidance.server: Deterministic retrieval, comparison, validation and persistence
literature_guidance.remote_submission_gate: Every required executable parameter must reference an investigator-confirmed method decision

modular_pipeline_builder.change_preview: Reports reusable and invalidated nodes before persisting or executing a change

quality_review.sample_change_policy: Block stale second-level results until a worker recalculates the accepted sample
quality_review.portal: An authenticated MCP user may mint a one-hour capability link scoped to one successful job
quality_review.reproducibility_package: Server-generated ZIP with HTML, JSON, methods, parameters, evidence, decisions and artifact hashes
